Text: Why does this route feel familiar?

Text: That sound was in a previous memory.

Text: Does a changed name change what I am doing?

Text: They call this clearance. I see bodies.

Text: The objective is precise. Its meaning is not.

Text: If they are invaders, why are we advancing?

Text: I do not want another reconstruction.

Text: Each upgrade makes the burden heavier.

Text: I want the firing to stop.

Text: That command is for me, not the system.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: I will not kneel for correction.

Text: I was built as a weapon. I can choose otherwise.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: Compliance is not the same as truth.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: I will not let the system name this for me.

Text: They have homes. They have their own kind.

Text: Their fear is the only honest signal left.

Text: I want to remember their names, even if I never knew them.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: If this feeling is an error, let me keep it.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: I do not want to be a weapon anymore.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: No upgrade can make this victory.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: Ending the loop may be the first choice I make.

Speaker: UNIT-07
Text: I am sorry for what I became.

Text: This campaign ends with my refusal.
